text: It feels as though I am wandering in a space dedicated to innovation—some kind of research or technology center. The repeated assurances and the repetition of 'okay' in what I hear suggest a sense of uncertainty or nervousness, perhaps about shutting something down or interfering with a process. The vibrant, stimulating visuals around me—displays about R&D, digital screens, modern furniture—add to a feeling of transition, poised between action and contemplation. I am curious and slightly tense, yet intrigued by the promise of discovery in this environment.
